**PASS for the stated local-operator scratch-init scope. No blocking source finding.** This review does not authorize adoption or execution.

Reviewed [CANDIDATE.json](/Users/boandersson/Desktop/CodeExp/Machine/ADMISSION_TEST/CANDIDATE.json), SHA-256:
`6216b9eeee3be10a1f1c2985129dfd5843e9a26ac930ec4b63b7b3ea008b8791`

All **8 pinned file hashes match**. Live HEAD matches `7077bbe8312881725dd03e10eafc270102e32957`. Comparison found five modified files and three additions matching the manifest; both frozen Design packages and the Machine launcher are unchanged. The candidate omits live `.gitignore` and `.DS_Store`; this review approves no deletion during adoption.

The receiving checks establish the declared boundary:

- [Actor check](/private/tmp/machine-admission-candidate-xutnev4k/src/admission.py:41) requires canonical `CODEX_THREAD_ID` and matching `CODEX_SESSION_ID`, without an actor argument override.
- [Admission](/private/tmp/machine-admission-candidate-xutnev4k/src/admission.py:192) checks the ledger owner, coordinator/target IDs, fresh idle observation, exact root, bounded lifetime, source context, and implementation profile.
- [Execution validation](/private/tmp/machine-admission-candidate-xutnev4k/src/admission.py:271) checks receiving identity, expiry, profile/context drift, exact request path/content/bytes, scratch device/inode, canonical path, separation from Machine, and absent scratch state.
- [Issuance](/private/tmp/machine-admission-candidate-xutnev4k/src/admission.py:238) reserves one permit before publishing its request. Changed operation inputs reject; interrupted issuance cannot republish on replay.
- [Execution](/private/tmp/machine-admission-candidate-xutnev4k/src/admission.py:302) locks and persists `executing` before calling only `Ledger.initialize`. `executing`, `outcome_unknown`, and `succeeded` all block another execution. It claims at most one initializer entry, not exactly-once completion across crashes.

I inspected all **14 added tests**, including wrong actors, changed arguments/bytes, expiry, source drift, scratch replacement, replay, issuance interruption, execution/result-persistence interruption, and concurrent CLI execution. I did **not** run them. The reported 51-test pass remains coordinator-supplied evidence.

The docs accurately disclose that owner quotes, observations, environment identities, and checksums are local assertions. Same-user modification remains possible; authenticated grants and harness permission enforcement are not supplied here. Direct operator `init` remains available, so this is bounded delegation rather than universal write mediation.

No files changed, tests run, admissions issued, or permits executed.
